title: Microsoft Edge: apply pending updates when the browser is idle
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and existing relaunch controls are supported, and it distinguishes the planned idle-restart change from documented behaviour. One minor clarification should acknowledge conflicting numeric policy values in another Microsoft reference.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes Edge applying pending updates when the browser is idle.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge can now apply pending updates when your browser is idle.

claims.claim: The roadmap says the Relaunch Notification policy is updated to let administrators manage organisational idle restarts.
claims.quote: We've updated the Relaunch Notification policy to allow you to manage idle restarts for your organization.

claims.claim: The printed Computer or User Configuration > Policies > Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Relaunch route reaches the named restart-notification policy.
claims.quote:
GP name: Notify a user that a browser restart is recommended or required for pending updates
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Relaunch

claims.claim: The registry control is RelaunchNotification, REG_DWORD, under SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, with 1 Recommended and 2 Required.
claims.quote:
Recommended (1) = Recommended
Required (2) = Required
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: RelaunchNotification
Value type: REG_DWORD
claims.fix: Keep the mapping from the cited RelaunchNotification reference. Add: 'Microsoft's RelaunchFastIfOutdated reference inconsistently calls value 1 Required, whereas the RelaunchNotification reference maps 1 to Recommended and 2 to Required.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/relaunchfastifoutdated.

claims.claim: The printed Computer or User Configuration > Policies > Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Relaunch route reaches Set the time period for update notifications.
claims.quote:

claims.claim: The notification period is set through RelaunchNotificationPeriod, REG_DWORD in milliseconds, under SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge.
claims.quote:
Allows you to set the time period, in milliseconds
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: RelaunchNotificationPeriod
Value type: REG_DWORD

claims.claim: The existing RelaunchNotification policy notifies users that Edge needs restarting to apply a pending update.
claims.quote: Notify users that they need to restart Microsoft Edge to apply a pending update.

claims.claim: When RelaunchNotification is unconfigured, Edge adds a recycle icon at the far right of the top menu bar to prompt a restart.
claims.quote: If you don't configure this policy, Microsoft Edge adds a recycle icon at the far right of the top menu bar to prompt users to restart the browser to apply the update.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Recommended produces a recurring warning recommending a restart.
claims.quote: If you enable this policy and set it to 'Recommended', a recurring warning prompts users that a restart is recommended.

claims.claim: Users can dismiss the Recommended warning and defer the restart.
claims.quote: Users can dismiss this warning and defer the restart.

claims.claim: Required produces a recurring warning about the impending automatic restart.
claims.quote: If you set the policy to 'Required', a recurring warning prompts users that the browser will be restarted automatically as soon as a notification period passes.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The existing Required policy value already restarts Edge automatically after the notification period.
claims.quote: If you set the policy to 'Required', a recurring warning prompts users that the browser will be restarted automatically as soon as a notification period passes.

claims.claim: The default relaunch notification period is seven days, or one week, when not set.
claims.quote: If not set, the default period of 604800000 milliseconds (one week) is used.

claims.claim: RelaunchNotificationPeriod configures the notification period used by RelaunchNotification.
claims.quote: The default period is seven days. You can configure this period with the RelaunchNotificationPeriod policy.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure and Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The RelaunchNotification page says the user's session is restored when the browser restarts.
claims.quote: The user's session is restored when the browser restarts.
